Within a block of 8 consecutive integers, the 'differ by 3 or 5' graph is the 8-cycle 1-4-7-2-5-8-3-6-1, whose maximum independent set has size 4, so at most 4 per block and at most 2 from the pair, giving <=26. Equality would force every block to contribute exactly 4, i.e. exactly the odd or exactly the even elements of that block (the only independent 4-sets of the cycle), and both 49 and 50 included. Consecutive blocks must have the same parity: odd block then even block contains 8k+7 and 8k+10 (difference 3); even block then odd block contains 8k+4 and 8k+9 (difference 5). So all six blocks share one parity; if odd, 47 and 50 differ by 3; if even, 46 and 49 differ by 3. Contradiction, so the maximum is 25.
